name: Prizor Viztech Ltd.
summary: Prizor Viztech Ltd. is an Indian company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of security and surveillance solutions, alongside a presence in consumer electronics. The company offers a comprehensive range of products including various types of CCTV cameras such as IP, HD analog, 4G, standalone, PTZ, and ANPR cameras, as well as network and digital video recorders, mobile DVRs, POE switches, and video management software. They are also developing AI-based surveillance products, including thermal cameras and facial recognition devices. Additionally, Prizor Viztech provides LED televisions, monitors, and interactive touch panels, catering to both security and general consumer electronics markets. The company serves a diverse client base across multiple sectors, including retail, government, education, infrastructure, private enterprises, residential, banking and finance, transportation, commercial, industrial, and public areas, with a focus on smart city initiatives and corporate security in India. Prizor Viztech operates on a manufacturing and trading model, with a manufacturing facility in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and distributes its products across India.
